hook.line: The odds of being dealt a royal flush in your first five cards — a once-in-a-lifetime miracle.
hook.say: Care to bet on the history of poker?

ch.say: It grew up on an American river.
p: Its roots are said to include French “poque” and German “Pochen”; some suggest the Persian “as-nas”.
In the early 19th century it spread as “poker” through New Orleans and the steamboats of the Mississippi.

ch.say: New ways to play kept appearing.
tl: A 20-card betting game recorded in New Orleans
Played with 52 cards; the flush appears
Hold’em is said to be born in Texas
First World Series of Poker in Las Vegas
An online qualifier, an amateur, wins the world title
The AI Pluribus beats top pros at six-player poker

ch.say: This is the best hand: a royal flush!
ch.cap: 10, J, Q, K and A of the same suit
p: Poker is fought not only with cards but with bets.
Even a weak hand wins if your rival folds — bluffing is the heart of the game.

cards: Two hole cards plus five shared cards — the tournament standard
Five cards, one chance to swap — the classic
Four hole cards, of which you must use exactly two
In 2003 accountant Chris Moneymaker went from an online qualifier to world champion — and poker exploded
Libratus beat pros heads-up in 2017; Pluribus beat them in multiplayer games in 2019

ch.say: Tap a card to flip it!
cards: From the expressionless faces of skilled poker players
Where did the joker come from?
It is said to start as the top card in the 19th-century American game euchre
One pair — about 42% of five-card deals

p: The cards are luck; the game is psychology. Show us your poker face.
